# Gaming-Optimized UWScript for Windows 11 Pro 24H2 # Check if script is running as Administrator If (!([Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal][Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()).IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]"Administrator")) { Try { Start-Process PowerShell.exe -ArgumentList ("-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File `"{0}`"" -f $PSCommandPath) -Verb RunAs Exit } Catch { Write-Host "Failed to run as Administrator. Please rerun with elevated privileges." Exit } }
# Set window title and color scheme $Host.UI.RawUI.WindowTitle = "Gaming-Optimized UWScript (Administrator)" $Host.UI.RawUI.BackgroundColor = "Black" Clear-Host
# Define marker file for specialize phase $markerFilePath = "C:\specialize_marker.txt" $isSpecializePhase = Test-Path $markerFilePath
# Gaming-focused bloatware packages to remove $appxPackages = @( 'Microsoft.Microsoft3DViewer', 'Microsoft.BingSearch', 'Microsoft.WindowsCamera', 'Clipchamp.Clipchamp', 'Microsoft.WindowsAlarms', 'Microsoft.549981C3F5F10', 'Microsoft.Windows.DevHome', 'MicrosoftCorporationII.MicrosoftFamily', 'Microsoft.WindowsFeedbackHub', 'Microsoft.GetHelp', 'microsoft.windowscommunicationsapps', 'Microsoft.WindowsMaps', 'Microsoft.ZuneVideo', 'Microsoft.BingNews', 'Microsoft.MicrosoftOfficeHub', 'Microsoft.Office.OneNote', 'Microsoft.OutlookForWindows', 'Microsoft.People', 'Microsoft.Windows.Photos', 'Microsoft.PowerAutomateDesktop', 'MicrosoftCorporationII.QuickAssist', 'Microsoft.SkypeApp', 'Microsoft.MicrosoftSolitaireCollection', 'Microsoft.MicrosoftStickyNotes', 'MSTeams', 'Microsoft.Getstarted', 'Microsoft.Todos', 'Microsoft.WindowsSoundRecorder', 'Microsoft.BingWeather', 'Microsoft.ZuneMusic', 'Microsoft.Xbox.TCUI', 'Microsoft.XboxApp', 'Microsoft.XboxGameOverlay', 'Microsoft.XboxGamingOverlay', 'Microsoft.XboxIdentityProvider', 'Microsoft.XboxSpeechToTextOverlay', 'Microsoft.YourPhone', 'Microsoft.OneDrive', 'Microsoft.MixedReality.Portal', 'Microsoft.Windows.Ai.Copilot.Provider', 'Microsoft.Copilot', 'Microsoft.WindowsMeetNow', 'Microsoft.Paint', 'Microsoft.MSPaint' )
# Gaming-Essential Registry Settings function Set-GamingRegistry { $MultilineComment = @" Windows Registry Editor Version 5.00
; === GAMING PERFORMANCE OPTIMIZATIONS ===
; Disable Windows Defender (for gaming performance) [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender] "DisableAntiSpyware"=dword:00000001
; Disable Cortana (reduces CPU usage) [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Search] "AllowCortana"=dword:00000000
; Disable Telemetry (improves performance) [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DataCollection] "AllowTelemetry"=dword:00000000
; Disable Windows Update during gaming [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate\AU] "NoAutoUpdate"=dword:00000001
; Gaming priority optimizations [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile] "SystemResponsiveness"=dword:00000000 "NetworkThrottlingIndex"=dword:0000000a
[HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile\Tasks\Games] "Affinity"=dword:00000000 "Background Only"="False" "Clock Rate"=dword:00002710 "GPU Priority"=dword:00000008 "Priority"=dword:00000006 "Scheduling Category"="High" "SFIO Priority"="High"
; Disable Xbox Game DVR for better gaming performance [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\GameDVR] "AllowGameDVR"=dword:00000000
; Disable OneDrive auto backup [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\OneDrive] "KFMBlockOptIn"=dword:00000001
; Prevent unwanted app installations [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\PushToInstall] "DisablePushToInstall"=dword:00000001
; Disable Windows Consumer Features (app suggestions) [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\CloudContent] "DisableWindowsConsumerFeatures"=dword:00000001
; Hide Chat/Teams icon from taskbar [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Chat] "ChatIcon"=dword:00000003
; Disable BitLocker auto-encryption (can impact gaming SSD performance) [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\BitLocker] "PreventDeviceEncryption"=dword:00000001 "@ Set-Content -Path "$env:TEMP\Gaming_Registry.reg" -Value $MultilineComment -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue Regedit.exe /S "$env:TEMP\Gaming_Registry.reg" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
# Remove OneDrive during installation function Remove-OneDrive { Remove-Item "C:\Users\Default\AppData\Roaming\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\OneDrive.lnk" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue Remove-Item "C:\Users\Default\AppData\Roaming\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\OneDrive.exe" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue Remove-Item "C:\Windows\System32\OneDriveSetup.exe" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue Remove-Item "C:\Windows\SysWOW64\OneDriveSetup.exe" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
# Disable Windows Recall (Copilot+ feature) function Disable-Recall { Dism /Online /Disable-Feature /Featurename:Recall /NoRestart | Out-Null }
# Set minimal gaming-focused services function Set-GamingServices { $disabledServices = @( 'DiagTrack', 'dmwappushservice', 'WerSvc', 'Fax', 'MapsBroker', 'RemoteRegistry', 'RemoteAccess', 'WSearch', 'XblAuthManager', 'XblGameSave', 'XboxNetApiSvc', 'XboxGipSvc' )
foreach ($service in $disabledServices) { try { Set-Service -Name $service -StartupType Disabled -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null } catch { # Silent continue if service doesn't exist } } }
# Disable gaming-disruptive scheduled tasks function Disable-GamingTasks { $tasks = @( "Microsoft\Windows\Application Experience\Microsoft Compatibility Appraiser", "Microsoft\Windows\Customer Experience Improvement Program\Consolidator", "Microsoft\Windows\Windows Error Reporting\QueueReporting", "Microsoft\Windows\Feedback\Siuf\DmClient" )
foreach ($task in $tasks) { try { schtasks /Change /TN $task /Disable 2>&1 | Out-Null } catch { # Silent continue if task doesn't exist } } }
# Main execution during specialize phase if (Test-Path -Path $markerFilePath) { # Remove bloatware apps Get-AppxProvisionedPackage -Online | Where-Object { $appxPackages -contains $_.DisplayName } | Remove-AppxProvisionedPackage -AllUsers -Online -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
# Apply gaming optimizations Set-GamingRegistry Remove-OneDrive Disable-Recall Set-GamingServices Disable-GamingTasks
exit }
# Interactive menu if run manually Write-Host "============================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan Write-Host " Gaming-Optimized UWScript for W11 " -ForegroundColor Yellow Write-Host "============================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan Write-Host "" Write-Host "1. Apply Gaming Optimizations" Write-Host "2. Remove Bloatware Apps" Write-Host "3. Configure Gaming Services" Write-Host "0. Exit" Write-Host ""
$choice = Read-Host "Select an option (0-3)"
switch ($choice) { "1" { Set-GamingRegistry; Write-Host "Gaming optimizations applied!" -ForegroundColor Green } "2" { Get-AppxPackage -AllUsers | Where-Object { $appxPackages -contains $_.Name } | Remove-AppxPackage -AllUsers -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue Write-Host "Bloatware removed!" -ForegroundColor Green } "3" { Set-GamingServices; Write-Host "Gaming services configured!" -ForegroundColor Green } "0" { exit } default { Write-Host "Invalid selection." -ForegroundColor Red } }
Pause

$targetFile = "C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\UWScript.ps1" $shortcutPath = "C:\Users\Default\Desktop\Gaming UWScript.lnk"
# Create WScript.Shell COM object $WshShell = New-Object -ComObject WScript.Shell
# Create a new shortcut $shortcut = $WshShell.CreateShortcut($shortcutPath)
# Set the target path to launch PowerShell with the script as an argument $shortcut.TargetPath = "C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe" $shortcut.Arguments = "-ExecutionPolicy Bypass -NoProfile -File `"$targetFile`"" $shortcut.IconLocation = "powershell.exe,0" $shortcut.WorkingDirectory = "C:\Windows\System32" $shortcut.Description = "Launch Gaming-Optimized UWScript with Administrator Privileges"
# Save the shortcut $shortcut.Save()
# Set the "Run as administrator" flag in the shortcut file $bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($shortcutPath) $bytes[21] = 34 # 0x22 (34 in decimal) sets the RunAs flag [System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($shortcutPath, $bytes)

# Gaming-Optimized User Customization for Windows 11 Pro 24H2 # Check if script is running as Administrator If (!([Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal][Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()).IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]"Administrator")) { Try { Start-Process PowerShell.exe -ArgumentList ("-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File `"{0}`"" -f $PSCommandPath) -Verb RunAs Exit } Catch { Write-Host "Failed to run as Administrator. Please rerun with elevated privileges." Exit } }
# Disable automatic restart of explorer.exe and set black background reg.exe add "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon" /v AutoRestartShell /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f reg.exe add "HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Control Panel\Colors" /v Background /t REG_SZ /d "0 0 0" /f RUNDLL32.EXE user32.dll,UpdatePerUserSystemParameters
# Stop explorer.exe temporarily Stop-Process -Name explorer -Force
Try { # Gaming-focused user registry optimizations $MultilineComment = @" Windows Registry Editor Version 5.00
; === GAMING-FOCUSED ACCESSIBILITY OPTIMIZATIONS === ; Disable all accessibility features that could interfere with gaming
; Disable Narrator completely [HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Narrator\NoRoam] "DuckAudio"=dword:00000000 "WinEnterLaunchEnabled"=dword:00000000 "ScriptingEnabled"=dword:00000000 "OnlineServicesEnabled"=dword:00000000 "EchoToggleKeys"=dword:00000000
[HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Narrator] "NarratorCursorHighlight"=dword:00000000 "CoupleNarratorCursorKeyboard"=dword:00000000 "IntonationPause"=dword:00000000 "ReadHints"=dword:00000000 "ErrorNotificationType"=dword:00000000 "EchoChars"=dword:00000000 "EchoWords"=dword:00000000
[HKEY_CURRENT_USER\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Narrator\NarratorHome] "MinimizeType"=dword:00000000 "AutoStart"=dword:00000000
; Disable Ease of Access features [HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Ease of Access] "selfvoice"=dword:00000000 "selfscan"=dword:00000000
; Disable accessibility sounds and warnings [HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Control Panel\Accessibility] "Sound on Activation"=dword:00000000 "Warning Sounds"=dword:00000000
; Disable StickyKeys (prevents Alt+Tab gaming issues) [HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Control Panel\Accessibility\StickyKeys] "Flags"="2"
; Disable ToggleKeys (prevents Num Lock sounds during gaming) [HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Control Panel\Accessibility\ToggleKeys] "Flags"="34"
; Disable FilterKeys/Keyboard Response (prevents key repeat issues) [HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Control Panel\Accessibility\Keyboard Response] "Flags"="2" "AutoRepeatRate"="0" "AutoRepeatDelay"="0"
; Disable SoundSentry (prevents visual alerts during gaming) [HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Control Panel\Accessibility\SoundSentry] "Flags"="0" "FSTextEffect"="0" "TextEffect"="0" "WindowsEffect"="0"
; === GAMING PERFORMANCE OPTIMIZATIONS ===
; Dark theme for better gaming aesthetics [HKEY_CURRENT_USER\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Themes\Personalize] "AppsUseLightTheme"=dword:00000000 "SystemUsesLightTheme"=dword:00000000 "EnableTransparency"=dword:00000001
; Disable mouse acceleration for gaming precision [HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Control Panel\Mouse] "MouseSpeed"="0" "MouseThreshold1"="0" "MouseThreshold2"="0" "MouseSensitivity"="10"
; Performance-focused visual effects [HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Control Panel\Desktop] "UserPreferencesMask"=hex(2):90,12,03,80,10,00,00,00 "FontSmoothing"="2" "MenuShowDelay"="0"
; Disable Game Bar and DVR for better gaming performance [HKEY_CURRENT_USER\System\GameConfigStore] "GameDVR_Enabled"=dword:00000000
[HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\GameBar] "UseNexusForGameBarEnabled"=dword:00000000 "AutoGameModeEnabled"=dword:00000001
[HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\GameDVR] "AppCaptureEnabled"=dword:00000000 "AudioCaptureEnabled"=dword:00000000 "HistoricalCaptureEnabled"=dword:00000000
; Disable notifications during gaming [HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\PushNotifications] "ToastEnabled"=dword:00000000
; Disable Copilot [HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsCopilot] "TurnOffWindowsCopilot"=dword:00000001
; Gaming-friendly File Explorer settings [HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced] "LaunchTo"=dword:00000001 "HideFileExt"=dword:00000000 "TaskbarAnimations"=dword:00000000 "ShowTaskViewButton"=dword:00000000 "ShowCopilotButton"=dword:00000000 "TaskbarMn"=dword:00000000
; Disable recent files tracking (privacy for gaming) [HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced] "Start_TrackDocs"=dword:00000000
; Classic right-click menu for faster access [HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Classes\CLSID\{86ca1aa0-34aa-4e8b-a509-50c905bae2a2}\InprocServer32] @=""
; Remove OneDrive from File Explorer [HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Classes\CLSID\{e88865ea-0e1c-4e20-9aa6-edcd0212c87c}] "System.IsPinnedToNameSpaceTree"=dword:00000000
; Clean taskbar for gaming [HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Taskband\AuxilliaryPins] "MailPin"=dword:00000000 "TFLPin"=dword:00000000 "CopilotPWAPin"=dword:00000000 "@ Set-Content -Path "$env:TEMP\Gaming_User_Registry.reg" -Value $MultilineComment -Force Regedit.exe /S "$env:TEMP\Gaming_User_Registry.reg"
# Set gaming-appropriate wallpaper $darkModeWallpaperPath = "C:\Windows\Web\4K\Wallpaper\Windows\img19_1920x1200.jpg" $defaultWallpaperPath = "C:\Windows\Web\4K\Wallpaper\Windows\img0_3840x2160.jpg"
$wallpaperPath = if (Test-Path $darkModeWallpaperPath) { $darkModeWallpaperPath } else { $defaultWallpaperPath }
reg.exe add "HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Control Panel\Desktop" /v Wallpaper /t REG_SZ /d "$wallpaperPath" /f | Out-Null rundll32.exe user32.dll, UpdatePerUserSystemParameters
$statusMessage = "Gaming optimizations applied successfully! ✓" } Catch { $statusMessage = "Failed to apply some gaming optimizations ✗" }
# Simplified XAML UI for gaming setup $xaml = @" <Window xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml" Title="Gaming Setup Complete" Width="600" Height="400" WindowStyle="None" WindowStartupLocation="CenterScreen" Background="Transparent" AllowsTransparency="True" Foreground="#ffffff" FontFamily="Segoe UI">
<Border CornerRadius="15" Background="#1a1a1a" Opacity="0.95"> <Grid> <Grid.RowDefinitions> <RowDefinition Height="*"/> <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/> <RowDefinition Height="*"/> <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/> </Grid.RowDefinitions>
<!-- Header --> <StackPanel Grid.Row="0" VerticalAlignment="Center" HorizontalAlignment="Center"> <TextBlock Text="🎮 Gaming Setup Complete" FontSize="28" HorizontalAlignment="Center" Foreground="#00ff88"/> <TextBlock Text="$statusMessage" FontSize="16" HorizontalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,10,0,0"/> <TextBlock Text="Optimized for Discord, Spotify, Steam, and browsers" FontSize="14" HorizontalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,5,0,0" Foreground="#cccccc"/> </StackPanel>
<!-- Gaming Status --> <StackPanel Grid.Row="1" HorizontalAlignment="Center" Margin="20"> <TextBlock Text="✓ Accessibility features disabled for gaming" FontSize="14" Foreground="#888888"/> <TextBlock Text="✓ Performance optimizations applied" FontSize="14" Foreground="#888888"/> <TextBlock Text="✓ Gaming-focused registry settings configured" FontSize="14" Foreground="#888888"/> <TextBlock Text="✓ Minimal services for better performance" FontSize="14" Foreground="#888888"/> </StackPanel>
<!-- Defender Status --> <StackPanel Grid.Row="2" VerticalAlignment="Center" HorizontalAlignment="Center"> <TextBlock x:Name="DefenderStatusText" Text="Windows Defender: Disabled for Gaming" FontSize="18" HorizontalAlignment="Center" Foreground="#ff6666"/> <TextBlock Text="Enable if needed after gaming setup" FontSize="12" HorizontalAlignment="Center" Foreground="#888888"/> </StackPanel>
<!-- Restart Button --> <Button x:Name="RestartButton" Grid.Row="3" Content="🚀 Restart to Complete Gaming Setup" Width="300" Height="50" FontSize="16" Background="#00ff88" Foreground="Black" BorderBrush="Transparent" Margin="20" HorizontalAlignment="Center"> <Button.Style> <Style TargetType="Button"> <Setter Property="Template"> <Setter.Value> <ControlTemplate TargetType="Button"> <Border Background="{TemplateBinding Background}" CornerRadius="10"> <ContentPresenter HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/> </Border> </ControlTemplate> </Setter.Value> </Setter> </Style> </Button.Style> </Button> </Grid> </Border> </Window> "@
# Load and show the XAML window Add-Type -AssemblyName PresentationFramework [xml]$xamlParsed = $xaml $xamlWindow = [Windows.Markup.XamlReader]::Load((New-Object System.Xml.XmlNodeReader $xamlParsed))
# Restart button event $xamlWindow.FindName("RestartButton").Add_Click({ $result = [System.Windows.MessageBox]::Show("Ready to restart and enjoy your gaming setup?", "Restart Now", [System.Windows.MessageBoxButton]::YesNo, [System.Windows.MessageBoxImage]::Question) If ($result -eq 'Yes') { reg.exe add "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon" /v AutoRestartShell /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f Start-Process -FilePath "shutdown.exe" -ArgumentList "/r /t 3" -NoNewWindow } })
# Show the window $xamlWindow.ShowDialog()
